lines.text: Hi, I am Nora from the photo group. Are you the new member coming to the show with me?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, I am Eli. My bus gets to Elm Stop at ten thirty. Is that near the hall?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, but the hall's main door is closed today. We can meet at the side door by the bookshop.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Did you say the door by the bus stop? I have not been there before.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: The door by the bookshop. From the bus stop, cross the street and turn right.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Thanks. Can we get a snack before we go in? I have eight dollars, and I do not eat meat.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: The fruit cup is six dollars, but the cheese roll is nine. We can get the fruit cup at the bookshop cafe.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Great. I'll see you at the side door at ten forty, then we can get the fruit.
lines.speaker: Eli
